sentences.en: It is served by steamer from Seattle, Washington; there is cable connexion with the United States, and a six-day mail service from Pacific ports, via Juneau.

sentences.en: It was here the sender knew a six-day sailing.

sentences.en: The six-day cruise departed on Sundays and took passengers through Key West, George Town, Grand Cayman and Jamaica before making the trip back to Florida.

sentences.en: If you win, the prize includes an all-expense paid, six-day package to take part in the Los Angeles Model & Talent Search in Los Angeles, California, which runs from January 5 - 10, 2009.
